8 احتمى He protected, defended, or guarded, himself, [or he became protected, &c.,] from a thing. (KL.) ―
-b2- And He (a sick man, K) refrained, forbore, or abstained, (K, KL,) مِنَ الطَّعَامِ [from food, or the food], (S,) or مِمَّا يَضُرُّهُ [from what would injure him]; (TA;) as also ↓ تحمّى . (K.) ٱحْتِمَايَا occurs at the end of a verse, preserving the original form, [for ٱحْتِمَآءَ,] accord. to a dial. of certain of the Arabs. (S.) ＝
-A2- احتمى غَضَبًا: see 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
